title: PSD — Avatar Render Pipeline
summary: Product/system design for a self-hosted AI avatar video pipeline: goals, stack decisions, data model, milestones with acceptance criteria, and compliance requirements.
scope: compliance gate (EU AI Act Article 50(4), YouTube altered_content)
notes: Hybrid document: contains problem statement, success criterion, non-goals, and requirements table C1-C5 (PRD signals) alongside stack decision tables with rationale and rejected alternatives (ADR-like, sections 2 and 4.1) and milestone acceptance criteria.
